goals: Chain preprocessing and a model in one Pipeline
Use ColumnTransformer for mixed numeric/categorical data
why: Pipelines are how professional teams make models reproducible and leak-free: the same steps run identically in CV, testing and production.
explain: A **Pipeline** is an assembly line: impute → scale → encode → model. Calling `.fit()` runs every step on the training data; `.predict()` applies the same fitted steps to new data.
Inside cross-validation, each fold refits the scaler and imputer on that fold's training part only. That removes a whole class of subtle **leakage** bugs.
**ColumnTransformer** applies different steps to different columns: scale the numeric ones, one-hot encode the categorical ones.
You save one object (`joblib.dump(pipe)`) and production gets exactly the same preprocessing. No more "it worked in the notebook".

example.title: Loan model pipeline
steps: cross_val_score(pipe, X, y, cv=5) runs all of it correctly per fold
example.result: One object, no leakage, deployable as a single file.

mistakes: Scaling the whole dataset before CV.
Forgetting handle_unknown="ignore" and crashing on a new category in production.
takeaways: Pipeline = preprocessing + model as one object
Fit once, deploy the same object

practice.code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.compose import make_column_transformer
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
X = pd.DataFrame({"income": [10, 20, np.nan, 15], "city": ["Pune", "Chennai", "Pune", "Delhi"]}); y = [0, 1, 0, 1]
pre = make_column_transformer((make_pipeline(SimpleImputer(strategy="median"), StandardScaler()), ["income"]),
                              (OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore"), ["city"]))
pipe = make_pipeline(pre, LogisticRegression()).fit(X, y)
print(pipe.predict(pd.DataFrame({"income": [18], "city": ["Mumbai"]})))

check.q: Main benefit of putting the scaler inside a Pipeline during CV?
options: Each fold's scaler is fitted on its training part only (no leakage)
check.why: The pipeline refits preprocessing per fold.

check.q: Which tool applies different preprocessing to different columns?
check.why: ColumnTransformer routes columns to their own transformers.
